newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - GeoTel, Axogen both gain.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - GeoTel, Axogen both gain.

text.p: GeoTel Communications Inc and Axogen Ltd both rose after Wednesday initial public offerings.

Shares of GeoTel, which develops telecommunications software, rose to 14-1/2 from their IPO price of $12. The company is based in Littleton, Massachusetts. Alex. Brown & Sons Inc was the lead underwriter of the offering.

Axogen units rose to 19-1/2 from their IPO price of 18 each. Merrill was the lead underwriter of the offering of 4.6 million units of the company, based in Bermuda and Ireland. Each unit consisted of one ADS of Axogen and one five year warrant to buy an ADS of Elan Corp Plc.
Axogen is getting all proceeds from the offering. It develops therapeutics for persons with neurological disorders. Elan Corp develops controlled-absorption drug delivery systems.
